phase.goal: Reuse the existing compact Week DEV chip as a dev-only runtime diagnostics disclosure without changing Week content, backend payloads, scoring, or production behavior.

wave.goal: Align the existing Week runtime disclosure surface to the approved helper behavior and close targeted frontend and packet-local read-only evidence without claiming canonical Today or Week ownership.

verification.command: corepack pnpm --dir frontend exec jest --runInBand test/app/week-page.test.tsx

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing Week DEV chip remains compact in collapsed state.
On /week in non-production, tapping the chip expands and collapses a local disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Week render-path labels are derived from existing page states and remain stable for canonical, in_progress, empty, error, auth_gate, and loading branches.
Production and non-Week routes remain inert and visually unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-unchanged Week proof plus packet-local read-only evidence and the local observability artifact identifiers.
Packet-local post-test review may finish as clean or degraded-but-expected, but it must not be no-evidence-blocker.

deferred_work.item: Any additional diagnostics fields beyond render path, bootstrap result, and current mode.
Any Day or multi-route redesign of the shell badge beyond the bounded / and /week helper entry points.
Any separate wave that intentionally owns canonical Today or Week emitter commands and closeout.
